quote: To evaluate the alignment with human decision patterns across agents with different personality traits, we obtained human trajectories and investigated which personality type of agent shows the most similar action decision pattern to humans.

We employed three individuals each played 10 games, resulting in two trajectories for each of the 15 games covered in the main paper. ... After gameplay, they proceeded to annotate the personality types of selected actions comprising other players' trajectories. ... Human annotators viewed state and action pairs (s_t , a_t ) and assessed whether a_t exhibited high tendency, low tendency, or neutrality with respect to the given personality type.
